notes.title: Mini Patch (1.0.6)
notes.notes:
Additions

Added a tip screen to the main menu.
Added combo numbers for purchased items on the pause screen.

Adjustments

Made all of the Nowhere enemies drop more star pieces.

Bug Fixes

Fixed a crash involving Nowhere enemies dying to certain items.
Fixed a crash when a [spoiler]parasite in the boss second phase[/spoiler] dies at the same time you do.
Fixed a crash when you spam the Steam overlay while dead.
Fixed a minor options menu navigation bug.

notes.title: Mini Patch (1.0.5)
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes

Fixed a crash when the cat parries [spoiler]the spiked tumor in the second phase of the boss[/spoiler]
Fixed rare instance where the desert flies would get lost and the level would never end.

notes.title: Mini Patch (1.0.4)
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes

Fixed the flail crashing the game when getting stuck between a rock and another object.
Fixed the flail ignoring invulnerability.
Fixed weapons getting stuck in rocks when you have the hammer item.

Balance

Grass now refills your combo bar/timer by .33 seconds per grass cut. Grass always spawns in groups of three, so cutting all three gets you a full second.

notes.title: Mini Patch (1.0.3)
notes.notes:

Fixed a weird crash that would occur on the game over screen when alt-tabbing.
Fixed the treasure chest sometimes spawning on top of the finish line in the desert area.

Adjustments

You can now pause while in the shop so you can check your items.

notes.title: Mini Patch (1.0.1)

notes.title: Demo Mini Patch
notes.notes:
Just pushed an update that should make the game Steam Deck compatible. I'm not going to officially mark as such until I know for sure that it works correctly.

- Added the ability to pause the game with a controller.
- Escape can now pause the game.
- Added some required redistributables (you probably already have these on your PC).

For those that have Steam Decks, let me know how the game runs, and if you run into any issues. The only previously known crashes involved a shader. 
(Both hitting enemies and being hit would cause a crash) 

You may have to restart Steam to download the update.

notes.title: Demo Patch
notes.notes:
Notes
First off, I just wanted to say thanks to everyone for giving the game a shot! 
I got a lot of valuable comments, suggestions, and bug reports this week. It was also great to see a grand majority of you were having a lot of fun with the game!

Suggestions and Quality of Life
[hr][/hr]
Rocks
I noticed a lot of people were not a fan of rocks dropping your combo. Initially this was put in place to stop people from using rocks as crutch. So to meet you halfway.. 

- Rocks no longer drop your combo⛏️
- Rocks now deplete your combo timer by 1/4🪨

This basically means you can hit a rock a couple times before you will drop your combo. Just make sure you hit an enemy right afterwards!

Flashing White, Screen Shake, and Hit Freeze 
- The white flash on death is now maroon, and less bright.
- Added an option to turn off full screen flashes.
- Added an option to turn off screen shake.
- Reduced the amount of hit freeze when striking non-enemies.

Gameplay Feedback
- Added feedback when you get healed by the green flower🌼
- Added feedback when your combo ends.
- Added red bars around the sides of the screen when you get hurt.
- Made the combo timer bigger and color coded.

Fixes
[hr][/hr]
- Fixed several crashes.
- Fixed saw-blade flower not colliding with trees.
- Fixed some menu navigation bugs.
- Fixed red centipedes not despawning.
